Looking at the documentation, I need to create a `block` genre figure for this certificate renewal workflow. The document shows the skeleton structure and explains that quotes are required for all labels, while ids are bare tokens.

For a block diagram showing the flow of certificate renewal automation through six components connected by five edges, I'll define each block with its id and label, then specify each edge connection in the order given.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal Job"
block caclient "CA Client"
block ca "Certificate Authority"
block deployagent "Deploy Agent"
block service "Service"

edge scheduler renewaljob
edge renewaljob caclient
edge caclient ca
edge renewaljob deployagent
edge deployagent service
```

This document captures the complete workflow:
- The **scheduler** initiates the renewal process by triggering the **renewal job** on a timer
- The **renewal job** orchestrates the certificate acquisition by calling the **CA client**
- The **CA client** communicates with the **certificate authority** to obtain the new certificate
- Once obtained, the **renewal job** hands off to the **deploy agent**
- The **deploy agent** restarts the **service** to apply the new certificate

All five connections flow logically from left to right (or top to bottom when rendered), showing the dependency chain and control flow of the automation system.
